sections.label: The opening
sections.para: A sold-out day of building with Lovable at the University of the Algarve, and the association behind it: 106 members, three pillars and a vision of a southern European innovation hub; the way to take the opportunity is to ship and repeat.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: A sold-out day; no coding needed; Algarve Evolution; its members; its vision and pillars; ship and repeat.

sections.label: A day to build something
sections.para: Free registration, Lovable credits, meals, mentors, a jury; students, professionals and the curious, at the UAlg TEC Campus in Faro, with thanks to the university's CRIA.

sections.label: Who Algarve Evolution are
sections.para: Begun in 2018 by local entrepreneurs; 106 active members, about €100 million turnover and 1,000 jobs, 142 events in two years; a national and international membership; a small team and a board of founders.

sections.label: The work, on three pillars
sections.para: Education with the university and schools; an incubator with Founder2Founder and INOVA Algarve 3.0 for tourism; the CCDR digitalisation platform, the Tech Hub Summit and 24 mapped communities.

sections.label: What I told the room
sections.para: The biggest opportunity of their lifetime, not the version in the news; doctors prototyping their businesses; build something someone else can use, and repeat.

sections.label: The Algarve and us
sections.para: A long history with the Algarve, team members who live there, meetups before Web Summit, and this morning's article on Lovable with SHarness.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: The figures are Algarve Evolution's own; the Portuguese opening is paraphrased; participants are not named; the winners were not known; my interest.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: My message, the transcript and photographs, and Algarve Evolution's site.
